title: Slushie Bar Salts Fresh Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Salts' Fresh Mint is a refreshing dive into the cooling world of mint. This e-liquid brings the bold and rejuvenating taste of mint leaves straight to your palate, offering a crisp and clean vaping experience that invigorates with every puff. The flavour is pure, natural, and straightforward, capturing the essence of freshly picked mint leaves. The Fresh Mint e-liquid is perfect for those who seek simplicity and clarity in their vape. The minty freshness delivers a satisfyingly cool sensation, ideal for cleansing the palate or enjoying a brisk vape break. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
